LanguageData.DevelopableAbility_AbnormalResistance.de: A developable ability that increases immunity gain speed, toxin resistance and disease resistance. Proficiency rises from enduring harsh environments and resisting disease.
LanguageData.DevelopableAbility_Botany.description: A developable ability that increases sowing and harvesting speed, harvest yield, and foraging efficiency. Proficiency rises through plant work.
LanguageData.DevelopableAbility_Botany.label: Botany
A developable ability that increases the body's energy circulation efficiency. Reduces nutrition consumption while well rested, and restores rest in proportion to the nutrition eaten.
LanguageData.DevelopableAbility_Healing.description: A developable ability that increases tend quality, medical and surgery speed, and surgery success chance. Proficiency rises from tending the wounded and performing surgery.
LanguageData.DevelopableAbility_Healing.label: Healing
LanguageData.DevelopableAbility_LuckOfTheSea.descript: A developable ability that increases fishing speed and yield, and may bring in extra rare catches while fishing. Proficiency rises through fishing.
LanguageData.DevelopableAbility_LuckOfTheSea.label: Luck of the Sea
LanguageData.DevelopableAbility_Magic.description: A developable ability that increases the rate at which neural heat dissipates and the neural heat limit. Proficiency rises through meditation and psycasting.
LanguageData.DevelopableAbility_Magic.label: Magic Arts
LanguageData.DevelopableAbility_Mineralogy.descriptio: A developable ability that increases mining and deep drilling speed, and mining yield. Proficiency rises through mining work.
LanguageData.DevelopableAbility_Mineralogy.label: Mineralogy
LanguageData.DevelopableAbility_WeaponAttunement.desc: A developable ability that increases melee hit chance and accumulates weapon proficiency while a melee weapon is equipped. Weapon proficiency grants a chance to reset attack cooldown and to critically hit. Proficiency rises through melee combat.
LanguageData.DevelopableAbility_ChainAttack.descripti: A developable ability that increases Strength and Dexterity with melee attack frequency in combat. The bonus rises while attacking and fades after attacks stop. Proficiency rises through melee combat.
LanguageData.DevelopableAbility_ChainAttack.label: ChainAttack
